digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verifier instrumentation and diagnostics
propositions: Diagnostic artifacts measuring completion-verifier runaway root cause exist on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx (commit 556708771e) but are not ancestors of origin/main, making ticket evidence unverifiable against main
Three diagnostic files (transcript markdown, transcript driver, matrix driver) should be landed on main as a separate change distinct from the 2948 implementation that also lives in commit 556708771e
The diagnostic artifacts follow established convention in docs/experiments/ (paired driver + findings) and are reusable across future step-floor changes, not throwaway

Completion-verifier runaway loops still occur on current main after recent merges, clustering on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets with multi-file acceptance criteria, consistent with context pre-selection as root cause
